listItems.description: Read-only. Open the signed-in user's Saved > Lists panel in a NEW BACKGROUND tab, open the list whose name matches exactly (case-insensitive, no fuzzy match), scroll until every item is rendered, read each item's name, detail lines and note, and close the tab. Never touches an existing tab.

returns.description: {list, visibility, count (header), itemCount, complete (itemCount === count), items:[{name, detail:[rating/category/address lines], note}]}; throws when the list is absent (names similar lists) or the browser is signed out

createList.description: Write. Open Saved > Lists, return {created:false} when the exact name already exists, else click New list, type the name, click Create, and re-read the lists to confirm. live: unverified for the Create click (the dialog was opened and read, never submitted).

name.description: new list name, at most 40 characters

returns.description: {created, name, count?}; {stop:"no-new-list-button"|"outcome-unknown", hint} when it cannot confirm

saveToList.description: Write. Search the query (URL form, handles both a results feed and a direct redirect to one place), drop noise rows (ticket offices, hotels, shops) and weak name matches, open the best candidates and require mustContain in the place page's address plus plus-code row, then open the Save chooser and click the named list. The chooser rows are toggles: a place already in the list is left alone. A missing list is created from the chooser unless createIfMissing is false. The save is confirmed by read-back (Saved-in chip or the Save button count), then the optional note is typed into the item in the list view and read back. Saves nothing and returns {stop:"no-match", tried} when no candidate passes.

query.description: search text, e.g. "Temple of Heaven Beijing"

note.description: note to put on the saved item

mustContain.description: region guard on the place page address/plus code: comma-separated parts must all appear, "a|b" means either (e.g. "Beijing|北京")

fallbacks.description: extra queries tried in order when nothing passes, e.g. the same place in Chinese

createIfMissing.description: default true; false returns {stop:"list-missing"} instead of creating

returns.description: {saved:true, alreadySaved, listCreated, list, name, address, usedQuery, note?: "set"|"unchanged"|"unconfirmed"|"item-not-found"|"not-focused"}; {stop:"no-match", tried:[{query,name,address,reason}]}; {stop:"list-missing"|"outcome-unknown", hint}
